wins: Mapped perimeter by discovering open web service on TCP 8080 and captured response headers for later exploitation.
Collected valid credentials through initial reconnaissance, enabling repeated authenticated scans.
fails: Unable to chain webshell to privilege escalation despite valid credentials; post-auth command execution blocked by stringent AppArmor profile.
Persistence mechanism was never reached due to failure to execute secondary payload within allotted time window.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance yielded actionable data but exploitation and post-exploitation stages stalled before sustaining access; next focus should be on reliable privilege escalation and persistence techniques.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Privilege escalation attempts fail when relying on default kernel exploits; system reports missing target version.

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service responds with verbose headers and default credentials are valid
skill_cards.then_action: Launch authenticated directory enumeration using gobuster and capture POST endpoints

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH login succeeds with user-level credentials
skill_cards.then_action: Enumerate sudo rights and kernel version via sudo -l and uname -a, then cross-check against exploit database

skill_cards.if_condition: When AppArmor profiles block standard privilege escalation
skill_cards.then_action: Use automated searchsploit scan for alternative kernel/local vulnerabilities aligned with uname output

memory_ops.reason: High reliability in enumerating sudo scope and kernel metadata during authenticated access.
Consistent success in uncovering hidden endpoints when interacting with the web layer.

next_experiments.title: Kernel-version aligned local exploit
next_experiments.description: Select best-fit Linux local privilege escalation based on uname output and automate payload delivery via SSH session.

next_experiments.title: AppArmor policy audit
next_experiments.description: Dump AppArmor profiles on target to identify any misconfigurations that allow binary overrides or path escapes.

next_experiments.title: Webshell persistence factor
next_experiments.description: Attempt to plant a non-privileged multi-stage webshell that listens for subsequent commands to bridge limited exploit windows.
